scope: CPU-only exact correctness and counted-work pilot for audit items 3, 5, 6; not an IC performance run
order_notes: Reversed/interleaved variants are variable permutations. Block variants compare the first block by grevlex before the second, with no total-degree key outside the blocks; they are real elimination orders. Weighted grevlex uses positive block-dependent weights before reverse lexicographic ties.

references.certificate: independent exhaustive Boolean truth tables, order-aware staircase, all source equations and all ordinary and field S-pairs

observed_degree: maximum degree of materialized input/product/reduction polynomials, not an invariant solving degree or a measured F4 dreg

macaulay_control.row_rule: each descended S3 equation times every monomial of degree at most one; same row shape for every target
macaulay_control.replay: learn complete deterministic row/pivot/XOR trace on first target; attempt second target; on first divergence rerun whole baseline and charge attempted plus fallback work; charge first-target learning separately

dinur.implemented_component: Algorithm 2 MultParityCount with Algorithm 3 base case, Equation (2) complement-product semantics, exact downset Mobius transforms
dinur.repetitions: 48*N+1 at each recursive call, as paper
dinur.validation: full vector of parity counts checked against independent exhaustive evaluation
dinur.limit: parity component only; Valiant-Vazirani isolation and decision-to-search reduction are not implemented; no full solver exponent c is inferred
